_source_note: Netbanking standing instructions are governed per-bank, with no single published cross-bank rulebook the way card networks have. These mnemonic codes and their soft/hard categorization are our own reasonable modeling of commonly-seen netbanking failure reasons, not an official published list. See notes/IDEA.md §9 for the same honesty point applied to retry limits.

SESSION_TIMEOUT.description: Bank portal session timed out during authorization

INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE.description: Insufficient balance in linked bank account

GATEWAY_TIMEOUT.description: Timeout between payment gateway and bank's netbanking system

SI_EXPIRED.description: Standing instruction validity period has ended

ACCOUNT_CLOSED.description: Linked bank account has been closed

ACCOUNT_FROZEN.description: Linked bank account frozen by the bank

INVALID_SI_REFERENCE.description: Standing instruction reference is invalid or not found
